scope: Targeted recheck of the user-supplied original Reddit thread and current local 29 September release. Other project dates are not blanket-refreshed.

projects.finding: Avia municipal component 63-6237 contains both roof clusters. Current developer website says Avia completed and Voya under construction, completing Fall 2026; a forecast is not certified occupancy.

caveats: Existing status and 25/34 storeys are corroborated by primary sources. Approximate 79.9/106.5 m vertical envelopes come from a secondary catalogue, not a current surveyed elevation.

Tower plates are interpreted from the developer amenity illustration registered to current City mapped footprint limits. Allow about 5 m for tower position/contour interpretation; this is not a statistical accuracy claim.
The 14 m podium, floor divisions, balcony projections, vertical fins and roof enclosures are simplified reference-based estimates. Exact as-built facade and slab dimensions have not been obtained.

Nine selected native City LOD2 scene leaves and the inherited municipal model do not contain either tower. Existing neighbouring source geometry is retained. No downloadable architect-native model was located.
